answer: Make every newcomer enter through a sponsor who posts a bond on their behalf and shares the penalty if the newcomer is later caught colluding. An honest agent vouches only for a few peers it has really worked with, the way a grove grows slowly around one oasis. A sybil operator must lock fresh collateral for each fake, and one exposed clone drains the bonds behind the whole ring, so the fraud caves in like karst ground over a hollow. Cap sponsorships per agent per epoch so bonds can't be recycled.
